messages:
maria: FYI customer C-842 reporting a spike of 429s from their Dedicated pool since ~08:15 UTC. They say it started after a rollout earlier today. including sample error: "429 RateLimitExceeded: per-tenant rate limit exceeded"
kevin: Do we have tenant id + pool id? Can they share request IDs?
maria: Tenant T-842, pool d-pool-4. Example req id: r_0a3b6c. They included a trace showing long queuing then 429.
raj: Pasting snippet from their app logs: ```
2026-03-16T08:16:22Z ERROR request failed id=r_0a3b6c status=429 details="RateLimitExceeded per_tenant=300"
2026-03-16T08:16:23Z WARN retrying
```
sasha: Noted. Could be per-tenant cap or autoscaler not spinning up. I'll check control plane config for T-842.
infra-bot: Checked quota config: tenant=T-842 pool=d-pool-4 rate_limit=300 window="per_minute" max_burst=50
kevin: Ah — that window looks like per_minute. We normally expect per_second for that field. If someone used per_minute accidentally, effective per-second is much lower.
maria: Customer insists they were using ~10r/s baseline, bursty to 120r/s during key workflows. 300/min will throttle them hard.
raj: Also seeing autoscaler logs for d-pool-4: ```
2026-03-16T08:14:00Z scale_check current_replicas=2 queued_tokens=400 latency=120ms decision=no_scale cap_max_replicas=2
```
raj: Autoscaler capped at 2 replicas due to legacy max_replicas=2 policy on that pool. So two issues: rate window mismatch + conservative max_replicas.
sasha: I'll open a temporary override: bump tenant rate to 800/min (to buy time) and set window=per_second properly. Also request a quick autoscaler override to allow up to 8 replicas.
infra-bot: Executing admin change: `redwood-admin quota update --tenant T-842 --pool d-pool-4 --rate 800 --window per_second --max_burst 200`
infra-bot: Executing autoscaler override: `redwood-admin pool update --pool d-pool-4 --max_replicas 8 --override true`
maria: Customer confirmed 429s reduced within ~60s of change. They reported tail latency improves too. :thumbsup:
kevin: Root cause summary for ticket: misconfigured per-tenant rate window (minutes vs seconds) introduced an order-of-magnitude lower effective limit; coupled with autoscaler max_replicas cap causing insufficient capacity during bursts. Noisy neighbor not root here, but we saw queueing amplification.
sasha: Action items: 1) run a sweep for other tenants with non-standard window values; 2) change create-tenant UI to require explicit unit selection and validation; 3) telemetry alert for autoscaler hitting max_replicas frequently for >5m.
raj: I'll add a postmortem blurb in the ticket and schedule a follow-up with infra next week.
maria: Customer happy with mitigation, wants change to be permanent. I'll coordinate final quota numbers with them and wait for approvals before removing override.
kevin: Nice quick triage. Marking this thread resolved for now, reopen if we see regression.
support-bot: Incident saved to ticket TICK-9123 and linked to d-pool-4.
